class.name: LocalLRTVolume3D
class.brief_description: Builds local LRT geometry and first-bounce lighting fields.
class.description: Builds dense signed distance and linear diffuse color fields for participating MeshInstance3D nodes. In Forward+ it can inject a directly lit, visibility-tested first bounce into standard material ambient diffuse lighting.

method.name: bake
method.description: Rebuilds the fields from participating meshes under the volume's parent.

method.name: clear
method.description: Clears baked data and debug geometry.

method.name: clear_lighting
method.description: Replaces the current first-bounce field with black while retaining the geometry fields.

method.name: get_field_summary
method.description: Returns grid sizes and classified cell counts.

method.name: inject_first_bounce
method.description: Recomputes the first diffuse bounce from visible native lights and publishes it to Forward+.

method.name: sample_first_bounce
method.description: Samples the linear receiver irradiance divided by pi at a volume-local position.

method.name: sample_sdf
method.description: Samples the signed distance at a volume-local position.

method.name: sample_nearest_surface
method.description: Returns signed distance, normal, linear color, and owner ID from the same nearest surface seed.

method.name: sample_surface_color
method.description: Samples linear diffuse color from an occupied color cell.
